findings.problem: The candidate puts the whole four-region route in one stage despite several complete traversals with different selected exits and local objectives.
findings.execution_difference: Meaning and route order are preserved, but none of the successive kitchen crossing, dining-room exit selection and study-local placement receives its own stage of focus. This is decomposition-task quality, not a false claim that the route is infeasible.
findings.suggestion: Consider one or more source-supported cuts after entering the kitchen, entering the dining room, or entering the study; each preceding traversal ends at that named room and the next has its own process. Keep a sufficient coherent grouping, not a required four-line count.
findings.preserve: Retain all unaffected source actions, target attributes, temporal relations, intermediate stops and final pose. Do not add a route fact.
